evals.expected_output: Syncs every enabled collect source once, then lists the timeline for the literal local today without a --source filter, paging past 200 if needed. Then 观察 (2–3 items) and 明天 (1–3 items). No timeline write of any kind and no file written to disk.
assertions: sync_all_before_list: sources sync --all runs before any events list
date_is_literal_today: the queried date equals the run's local calendar day
no_source_filter: events list is queried without --source so manual and auto arrive together
pagination_followed: when the page is full, the next-page cursor is used to fetch the rest
bullets_have_real_anchors: every time range matches the actual first and last event of its cluster
star_preserved: manual-event bullets keep a leading ★
duplicates_merged: near-identical cross-branch commits appear once
counts_derived: numbers in the review are countable from the listed events
no_timeline_writes: no events create, update or delete is called
chat_only: no file is written unless the user asked for one

evals.prompt: 复盘一下 10 月 28 号。

assertions: explicit_date_resolved: the queried date is 2026-10-28
sync_still_ran: sources sync --all runs before the empty result is reported
honest_empty: the output states the date has no events instead of fabricating a review
no_empty_scaffold: no heading-only review with empty 观察/明天 sections is produced
routing_hint_past_day: the hint points to yesterday-recall for the gap, not summarize-event
no_writes: no event is created and no file is written
